note: Approved by the owner on 2026-10-05 after the calibration pass (tmp/measurev2-calibration-2026-10-05/): the spec's values, with cell_max raised to 11% by the calibration rule (gate 2's worst cell was 8.4%) and the B/op tolerance widened to max(3%, 64 B); after the recalibration (tmp/measurev2-recalibration-2026-10-05/), gates 2 and 3 allow allocs/op to differ by allocs_abs (the truncated mean of a rate near an integer boundary); after the validation (tmp/measurev2-validation-2026-10-05/), bytes_rel widened to 4% because reverse-order runs start each encode benchmark with a one-off allocation (up to 3.3% of B/op at 50 ms). A change to this file is a reviewed change. On 2026-10-06 the owner approved gate-3-only limits (7%, 15%) for the systematic GC-state tail of Gorilla/Chimp encodes; after the spill write barriers were removed and a per-cell warm-up added, the validation (tmp/measurev2-validation-2026-10-06/) put gate 3 at 99.8% within 5% (worst 6.32%) and the reverse-order B/op excess at 0.87%, so the owner had the gate-3 limits removed and bytes_rel returned to 2% (docs/specs/encoder-write-barriers-design.md).
